summary: RE-REVIEW after the rebase onto #946 (86555a29). The pin at 70c3dff0 is void and its record is deleted in this same commit. Rebase integrity: the CONTENT of the diff vs the new base is byte-identical to the diff I reviewed — I stripped blob-hash and hunk-offset lines and compared the 66 changed lines directly; only line numbers moved, because #946 added roughly 289 lines above in the same file. Verified both changes coexist in the rebased file: #946's protective-exit logic is present (6 references to _is_protective_v2_exit/_PROTECTIVE_V2_EXIT_REASONS) alongside #944's shared classifier (2 references to is_schwab_opening_ineligible_reason); the two touch different regions of oms/service.py (entry-refusal caching vs the managed-exit path) and do not interact. Ancestor test PASS against base 86555a29. Both commits carry exactly one recognised agent marker, authored by codex, so reviewer differs from every author in the range. Behaviour re-verified on the rebased head, not carried over: the side-by-side against main's live matcher shows ZERO regressions, all seven Schwab ineligibility phrasings latch, and an unrelated 'oversold' refusal correctly does not. Mutations re-run on the rebased head against tests/unit/test_oms_risk_service.py + test_broker_refusal.py (112 passed baseline): drop the restored broad fragment -> 1 failed RED; drop 'not eligible for electronic entry' -> 4 failed RED; classifier always False -> 11 failed RED. ONE MUTANT SURVIVED AND I PROVED WHY RATHER THAN EXCUSING IT: dropping 'opening transactions for this security must be placed with a broker' leaves all 112 tests green because that phrase CONTAINS the shorter 'must be placed with a broker' fragment, so it is redundant; I confirmed byte-identical classifier output across nine inputs with and without it. That is an EQUIVALENT MUTANT, not an uncovered branch. Minor, non-blocking: the tuple therefore carries one redundant entry, and a future reader might wrongly conclude the short fragment is the removable one. Controlled full unit pair vs the NEW base 86555a29: base 46 failed/3574 passed, head 46 failed/3576 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed, compared as sorted sets. Ruff clean on src+tests.
